Maria (People Ops): Heads up — ATS vendor scheduled a brief maintenance window tonight 11:00pm PT -> 11:45pm PT. They'll put the instance in read-only mode for ~30m. Last time we saw interviewer assignments detach and some scorecards orphaned. Need a short checklist and a reconciliation plan. Sam (Recruiter): Ugh, remembered that. Can we freeze new interview scheduling and batch notifications? :grimacing: Jordan (HRIS): Yes please freeze scheduling. I can add a flag to block webhook deliveries to calendar during the window. Kevin (Eng): We should also snapshot the assignments table and have a quick reconcile script ready. I can prep a small SQL diff and a rollback path. Lisa (PM): FYI we have candidate emails outbound for offers at 11:10pm — might overlap. Can we postpone those sends by 30m? Sam (Recruiter): I'll hold the outbound offer job manually. infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: ATS provider will enter read-only at 2026-03-23T06:00:00Z for ~45m. Maria (People Ops): OK action items: 1) Freeze scheduling + block webhooks (Jordan) 2) Pause outgoing offer emails (Sam) 3) Snapshot DB + run reconcile if drift (Kevin) 4) Post-mortem checklist (me) — can we confirm owners? Jordan (HRIS): I'll add the webhook block and post a confirmation in #people-ops when it's live. Kevin (Eng): Sharing quick reconcile command I'll run if we detect drift — paste for ops run: ```bash
# snapshot assignments before maintenance
pg_dump -t public.interviewer_assignments --schema-only > /tmp/assignments_schema.sql
psql -c "copy (select id, interviewer_id, interview_id, assigned_at from public.interviewer_assignments where assigned_at > now() - interval '7 days') to stdout with csv" > /tmp/assignments_before.csv
# quick reconciliation: find interviews with missing assignments and reattach
psql -c "\copy (select i.id as interview_id from public.interviews i left join public.interviewer_assignments a on a.interview_id = i.id where i.scheduled_at > now() - interval '30 days' and a.id is null) to '/tmp/unassigned_interviews.csv' with csv"
# reassign using mapping file (ops only)
./scripts/reassign_from_csv.sh /tmp/unassigned_interviews.csv
``` Kevin (Eng): I'll also stage a dry-run that logs potential reassignments and requires :thumbsup: from Jordan before applying. Sam (Recruiter): If any scorecards orphan, what's the user-visible impact? Maria (People Ops): Orphaned scorecards still exist but they're not linked to interview records — reviewers can't find them from interview view. We'll need to re-link by interview id. Jordan (HRIS): I can write a small migration to relink where possible, using matching candidate_id+round as heuristic. Will warn if ambiguous. Lisa (PM): Can we add a very short blurb in the candidate-facing FAQ if interviews are rescheduled? Sam (Recruiter): I'll draft candidate message and hold it until after maintenance. Maria (People Ops): Who's on-call to run reconcile if infra-bot detects >5 missing assignments? Kevin (Eng): I'm on-call tonight, will be available. Jordan (HRIS): I'll monitor webhooks and the freeze flag. infra-bot: Reminder scheduled at 2026-03-23T05:50:00Z (10m before maintenance). Maria (People Ops): Thanks team — I'll assemble a 1-page doc with these steps and post to #people-ops and #eng-oncall. After maintenance we'll compare /tmp/assignments_before.csv -> /tmp/assignments_after.csv and decide. Please react with :white_check_mark: once you have your task covered.
